ABOUT THE SPHERE

More than
a community.

The Sphere is a women’s wellness community created to bring together experiences that nurture the mind, body and soul.

Through thoughtfully curated gatherings, wellness practices and meaningful connections, Sphere creates spaces for women to pause, reconnect and celebrate life.

Calmness crafted for The Modern Women.

  • CACAO
  • BREATHWORK
  • SOUND HEALING
  • FIRE CEREMONY
  • CELEBRATION
  • MUSIC

GOOD TO KNOW

Frequently asked
questions.

What is The Sphere Wellness Carnival? +

The Sphere Wellness Carnival brings together ancient rituals, mindful practices, expert conversations, nourishment and music – all in one immersive evening. A journey that moves from connection and reflection to energy and celebration.

When and where is the event? +

20 December 2026, from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM at Jenney's Club, Coimbatore.

Do I need prior wellness experience? +

No. The experience is designed to be accessible to participants.

Is alcohol served? +

No. An alcohol-free celebration bringing everyone together through music and good energy.

Can I attend alone? +

Yes. The event is designed to encourage community and meaningful connections.

Is dinner included? +

Dinner is part of the event schedule.
